title: FBI Photo B6
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report containing a single still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect due to a system error.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome surveillance photograph showing two dark objects, one structured with an appendage and one circular, captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A dark, structured object with an appendage on its left side is visible just at the top of the reticle.
incidents.shape: structured object with appendage, circular object
